propositions: Code review has no existing concurrency correctness rubric; races like unlocked git-index writes and TOCTOU lockfile reclaims are not caught by security or performance overlays or base reviewers.

A lockset-first (Eraser/RacerD) concurrency overlay must be added to Pass-1 of the code-review gate, firing via deterministic lexical triggers on synchronization primitives (committed tier) and project-specific keywords (noisy tier).

The committed high-precision trigger tier must fire only on hunks bearing explicit sync tokens (Lock, flock, RwLock) and is expected NOT to trigger on modal unlocked-twin races (raw git rm+commit, getmtime+os.remove), with that gap intentionally filled by project-extensible routing in .rebar/criteria_routing.json.

Projects can extend built-in overlay trigger vocabularies and applies_to globs through .rebar/criteria_routing.json without code changes; rebar itself must dogfood this mechanism with noisy-tier concurrency vocabulary.

The concurrency overlay must ship in advisory mode (block_threshold 0.95, blocking_enabled false) pending calibration volume, with known blind spots (no-twin races and CI-level CAS backoff) documented rather than promised.
